hints.title: Report Reason Post Deduplication
hints.text: Count unique posts flagged for each reason on the target date 2019-07-04.

hints.title: Filtering on Action Type and Date
hints.text: Filter actions where date is 2019-07-04 and action equals report, then group by the extra reason field.

hints.title: Reported Posts Blueprint
hints.text: select extra as report_reason, count(distinct post_id) as report_count from Actions where action_date = "2019-07-04" and action = "report" and extra is not null group by extra.

hints.title: Complete Implementation
hints.text:
```mysql
SELECT extra AS report_reason,
       COUNT(DISTINCT post_id) AS report_count
FROM Actions
WHERE action_date = '2019-07-04'
  AND action = 'report'
  AND extra IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY extra;
```

variables: R: number of unique report reasons
complexity.notes: Filtering on date and action followed by hash aggregation on reasons executes in linear time.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Failing to deduplicate posts counts multiple reports of the same post by different users.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Grouped distinct counts evaluate unique post coverage with minimal auxiliary space.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Use of COUNT(DISTINCT post_id) and filtering for action = report on target date.
